title: xeraea incana
intro: Xeraea incana, commonly known as Yerba Santa, is a perennial shrub native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. It is valued for its medicinal and spiritual properties, as well as its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing respiratory issues, and supporting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Yerba Santa include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Yerba Santa include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
